summary: Frontend-only testing of UniTech super-admin Cuentas redesign. All consolidated-drawer flows pass: list/search/filter, unified Drawer with Plan/Tarjetas/Actividad/Acciones tabs, set-plan, card-limit update + restore, comp panel reveal, delete confirm (cancelled), impersonate + restore, all 5 AdminTabs navigate, Invitaciones toggle loads. No critical issues found.

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' - minor accessibility issue. Add SheetDescription / aria-describedby to the Sheet/Dialog content to silence and improve a11y.

action_items: (Optional, minor) Add `aria-describedby` / `SheetDescription` to AdminAccountDrawer's SheetContent and to CreateUserDialog's DialogContent to silence Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminAccountDrawer.js: PlanTab `initial` is computed once via useMemo on mount, but local `plan` state isn't re-synced if the parent user prop changes after a save (load() in parent updates `users` and re-passes `selected`). Currently the drawer is keyed by user.id implicitly via Sheet rendering; works fine in practice but a useEffect([user.id]) -> setPlan(currentPlan(user)) would be safer.

AdminAccountDrawer ActionsTab uses three native window.confirm + window.prompt calls in sequence for delete; works but is jarring on mobile. Consider a single AlertDialog with email-input confirmation for better UX (not blocking).
AdminAccounts.js InvitesTab uses window.confirm for revoke - same minor UX note.

ActivityTab shows 'Trial vence …' only when `user.trial_ends_at` truthy; verified OK in this env. Also note: `ShipmentEditor` doesn't reset internal state when `shipment` prop changes for a different user — since drawer re-mounts per user this is fine, but worth noting.
AdminAccounts.js is 800+ lines; consider splitting CreateUserDialog and InvitesTab into their own files for maintainability.
test_credentials: Used pzsuave007@gmail.com / Uni2mkt007! (super-admin) and target test account mktonly_test@example.com. After plan-save the user was set to 'marketing' which is the original manual_plan, so no restore needed. Card limit was changed from 1 -> 2 and successfully restored back to 1.
seed_data_creation: None. Did NOT delete any account. Did NOT actually grant comp (selected 'Cortesía' to reveal panel, then switched back to 'marketing' without clicking save). Impersonation was performed and reverted via 'Volver a mi cuenta' banner.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All testids verified present: accounts-search-input, accounts-filter-status, filter-{all|trialing}, create-account-btn, accounts-table-row (70 rows in env), user-detail-drawer, user-drawer-tab-{plan|nfc|activity|actions}, plan-select-dropdown, plan-option-{marketing|comp}, plan-save-btn, comp-note, card-limit-input, card-limit-save-btn, action-impersonate-btn, action-delete-account-btn, view-invites, admin-tab-{cuentas|metricas|mensajes|leads|envios}. The impersonation banner correctly shows 'Volver a mi cuenta' on dashboard. The Activity tab empty state shows 'Sin envío de tarjeta NFC registrado para esta cuenta.' + Registered date + 'Trial vence' for trialing users — no crash. Console emits Radix a11y warnings (missing DialogDescription/aria-describedby) — cosmetic only.
